name: Sister Sister ~Koi no Heartful Panic~
original_name: シスターシスター ～恋のハートフルパニック～
source:
Main character lives with his brother and girl Futaba brought by his father. They grow up as a happy family together. But everything changes when Futaba receives an unsigned love letter containing only "I love you" line. At the same time new transfer student also appears to be their distant relative and thus also an older sister. Brothers decide each to choose his sister, but the decision won't come without a conflict.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/08/vn-of-month-september-2004-abandoner.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
主角和弟弟、父親帶回來的女孩雙葉一起長大，一家人過得很幸福。直到雙葉收到一封沒有署名、只寫著「我愛妳」的情書，一切都變了。這時，新來的轉學生似乎也是他們的遠親，算起來還是兩人的姊姊。兄弟倆決定各自選一個姊妹，卻免不了為此起衝突。

[出自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/08/vn-of-month-september-2004-abandoner.html]vndbreview[/url]]
